		<title>California Expands Privacy Protections by Strengthening Deletion Rights</title>
		<link>https://privacy.ca.gov/2026/09/california-expands-privacy-protections-by-strengthening-deletion-rights/</link>
		
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[nicolecameron]]></dc:creator>
		<pubDate>Mon, 28 Sep 2026 00:03:19 +0000</pubDate>
				<category><![CDATA[Press release]]></category>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://privacy.ca.gov/?p=386292</guid>

					<description><![CDATA[The legislation was authored by Senator Josh Becker (D-Menlo Park) and sponsored by the California Privacy Protection Agency. ]]></description>
										<content:encoded><![CDATA[<p>September 27, 2026 SACRAMENTO, CA — Today, Governor Newsom signed the Expanding Privacy Rights Act (SB 923, Becker), closing a loophole in the California Consumer Privacy Act’s (CCPA) right to delete and making it easier for consumers to exercise their privacy rights. The legislation was authored by Senator Josh Becker (D-Menlo Park) and sponsored by the California Privacy Protection Agency.</p>
<p><a href="https://privacy.ca.gov/2026/09/california-expands-privacy-protections-by-strengthening-deletion-rights/" rel="nofollow">Source</a></p>]]></content:encoded>

		<title>California Legislature Advances Bill to Strengthen Deletion Rights</title>
		<link>https://privacy.ca.gov/2026/08/california-legislature-advances-bill-to-strengthen-deletion-rights/</link>
		
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[nicolecameron]]></dc:creator>
		<pubDate>Fri, 28 Aug 2026 07:01:12 +0000</pubDate>
				<category><![CDATA[Press release]]></category>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://privacy.ca.gov/?p=386158</guid>

					<description><![CDATA[This bill will bring the CCPA’s deletion rights in line with those provided in other states.]]></description>
										<content:encoded><![CDATA[<p>August 28, 2026 SACRAMENTO, CA — The California Privacy Protection Agency (CalPrivacy) applauds the California State Legislature for approving the Expanding Privacy Rights Act (SB 923), which will expand the California Consumer Privacy Act’s (CCPA) right to delete to cover all non-exempt personal information collected about them. It will also make it easier for consumers to submit privacy requests.</p>
<p><a href="https://privacy.ca.gov/2026/08/california-legislature-advances-bill-to-strengthen-deletion-rights/" rel="nofollow">Source</a></p>]]></content:encoded>

										<content:encoded><![CDATA[<p>August 25, 2026 SACRAMENTO, CA — Since launching on January 1, California’s Delete Request and Opt-out Platform (DROP) has crossed a major milestone: More than 500,000 Californians have registered. Signing up for DROP is quick, easy, and impactful. It’s a one-time process that generally takes less than 10 minutes. Data brokers must delete eligible personal information of the individuals who signed…</p>
